title: Biased Fourier coefficient as an expectation
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $p\in(0,1)$, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, and let $S$ be a set of coordinates. The biased Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $S$ equals the expectation of the product of $f$ and the biased monomial associated to $S$, under the product distribution with bias parameter $p$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
